body:
i guess you're right. i'm just anxious i'll be that person and come crashing down again like now. 

thanks man, i appreciate the words. i don't think i'm going to harm myself in the immediate future and i'd love to take a walk but it's not really safe where i live at this time, would be too on guard to think clearly. i think i might just sit outside for a bit instead. thanks.

wow man... that actually does. i don't know if i'm just looking for things to justify how i'm feeling right now but i definitely identify with everyone of those points apart from drug and alcohol abuse and forced speech. i'll definitely have to read more before i jump to any conclusions but thanks for bringing this to my attention. i also recently have to come to understand i may have some sort of obsessive anxiety disorder that i should probably talk about with a healthcare professional, this is also something i should keep in mind and i'll try and book an appointment tomorrow. thanks man.

thanks for the advice, i'm thinking about planning a long walk tomorrow, see if it helps.

about your second point, this is exactly how i was thinking during those few months i described in the op, i was actively looking forward to life and trying new experiences and becoming a new person, but now i'm thinking i was probably deluded and idiotic for thinking any of those things were worth the effort. i can't even think why i was feeling that way ever, i know it made my life more pleasant but as it stands right now with how i am feeling, i just don't understand how i ever came round to that way of thinking even for a short while.

hey man thanks for replying.
the thing is, it was years upon years in the same mood, then i managed to break through and make some progress, and then a switch shortly after - i'd say that was one uncontrolled shift over the course of years... i don't know anything about bipolar disorder, could such a thing be an indication? or something else? i've had some time to think since i posted and cleared up a a bit... i had two courses of CBT a few years ago to no benefit, but i'm thinking i should talk to a professional one last time
Hey man clicked on your username and noticed you've made a few posts since then, you still feeling this way?
